comment: The three parameters are reached only from the context menu and have no widget on the panel, so they are untagged. Menu item names were read from appendContextMenu in src/modules/Zilah.cpp: Midi 1.0, No Zeroing, No Waiting, MSB waits for LSB, MSB LSB pair, a Filter Smoothing slider and Unipolar. The MSB waits for LSB line trips validate_help.py's personification rule on the word 'waits', which is part of the item's printed name and cannot be reworded without falsifying it; that is the one validator hit left in this file. The MIDI device is chosen on Rack's own MidiDisplay widget on the panel, not from the module's right-click menu.
